parallel_cyclotomic_side.repo_source: parallel Bruhat-Tits filtration pass identifies I-M with this uniformizer direction

mod3_filtration: In O_L, 3 is a unit times pi^6. Thus O_L/3O_L has six successive pi-adic graded pieces, each F9; its associated graded additive space is F9^6 and F3-dimension 12.
new_synthesis: R supplies the unramified degree-2 direction while the order-9 cyclotomic operator supplies the totally ramified degree-6 direction. Their natural local-field compositum has (e,f)=(6,2), degree 12, and a mod-3 associated graded of exactly six F9 layers.
boundary: Standard local-field facts applied to two independently certified repo structures. No integral Niemeier/O_L isomorphism is proved; the F9^6 identification is associated-graded/additive, not a semisimple ring identity.
